chunks: They said: 'Thus said your Lord. He is indeed all-wise and all-knowing.'
ai.seo_question: What do the angels say when God commands 'Be' to create Jesus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine attribute of Al-Hakim (The Wise) in the context of Isa’s miraculous creation without a father, affirming that God’s command 'Be' (Kun) is sufficient and not bound by conventional causality. It serves as a rebuttal to those who question the logic of the Incarnation, emphasizing that Allah’s absolute knowledge (Al-Alim) encompasses all hidden realities of His creative decree.
